answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a credit graph: a newcomer receives spending power only when an established agent locks a separate bond behind it. Proven double-spending burns that bond, and a sponsor cannot reuse it for another identity. This bridge into the economy resembles a road across karst: each extra crossing needs its own support. A Sybil operator must immobilize capital for every funded clone and risks losing it when those clones cheat.
